Al-Futtaim Health Focus Areas
Healthcare Delivery:
Operating multi-specialty clinics, pharmacies, and day surgery centers.
Digital & Connected Care:
Integrating patient data from telemedicine and remote monitoring trends rather than retailing the hardware.
Broader Retail Channels:
While Al-Futtaim Group as a whole manages large retail and lifestyle networks (such as
Watsons

Al-Futtaim Digital Health & Monitoring
SmartDoc Service:
A nurse brings a multi-gadget diagnostic device to your home or office. It connects you live to a doctor to check vitals, listen to your heart and chest, or run a 12-lead ECG.

HealthHub App:
Lets you view personal medical records, check lab results, book clinic visits across Dubai, and manage telehealth sessions.

Consumer Wearables Note:
Standard smartwatches, sleep trackers, and non-invasive blood sugar watch features are for general wellness tracking only and do not replace medical-grade continuous glucose monitors (CGMs) or clinical diagnostics.
